Boxes fit the 16 Nov f2/f4 shots (her at about 960,540; boss body 740-1140 x 485-565); re-fit when a frame is re-shot. her_skin [944,506,974,527] (face, shoulders, chest) and her_hair [951,493,969,507] (the head only, inside her line) are her px only: no ground in the box (16 Nov, h3). her_shadow has no key on purpose: it measures the ground right under her feet, which must sit in the shadow band (a keyed dark box picks her boots). e3f_* (16 Nov, lead 3's dry-run shoot): copies of the f2_*/f4_boss entries, but boss_body/boss_back/boss_mane re-boxed on the probe mask (foe_den[15]=1, --env-off glow; mb2.py's split: back = h 240-340, C > .01, L > .25; mane = C > .05, h 345-60; body = the rest) as boxes inside each part (fitted at >= 93% of the keyed px in the part). bc1_a_02.png: the boss-clear frame (her clear of the Pack-Mother mid-lunge), the same three classes fitted the same way, plus the whole-frame rot_glow and fungus; its ground_lit and blood are not boxed. l6_* (17 Nov, lane E lead 6): l6_st2_00/01 = the storm at 3.5/4.5 s, pack re-boxed from the pack-mask twins l6_stm2_00/01 (fden[15]=1, pack px G > 150 and G - R > 40, opened 1 px, blobs >= 60 px, eroded 1 px, 4 px cells merged in row runs); her_hair copied from e4_storm. l6_sun and l6_boss: copies of e4_sun/e4_boss (the same sims as fin_sun/fin_boss, pixel-matched). Judge 4 (17 Nov, lead 6's round): l6_boss boss_body boxes also drop the warm stepped rim (not h 40-90 C > .06; the body's hue is right, the band stays 0-40); storm her_hair box (944,505,968,526), L capped .75 so her skin stays out.
